description: The figures of an area or a street of Spain, as on its unacasa page and in its CSV: population, age, income, declared and estimated rent, estimated values, the homes by kind and size, official price trend and sales (municipalities), cost of living, crime (Madrid districts), services, climate, elections ... Each row has id, label, value, unit, period and source; a street also lists its full building table (CSV/JSON link). Each answer starts with cite_as: the source line with the link of the unacasa page.

path.description: path of the unacasa page, e.g. /madrid, /madrid/zona-malasana, /madrid/distrito-chamberi, /28006, /madrid/calle-alcala

place_id.description: a place_id from find_place (municipality, district, neighbourhood, postal code)

name: get_place_facts
title: Area or street facts
